title.narrative: Pacific Community Strategic Partnership and core funding 2024 - 2026

description.narrative: Australia's provision of predictable, multi-year core funding to the Pacific Community (SPC) of $44 million over 3 years (2024-2026) underpins our 10-year Strategic Partnership Framework (2024-2033). This core funding will support SPC's corporate functions, cover the costs of senior SPC staff, and enable the organisation to manage emerging priorities. Our core investment also supports SPC manage other DFAT investments to Divisions in the organisation, including Fisheries, Aquaculture and Marine Ecosystems division (FAME), the Educational Quality and Assessment Programme (EQAP), Human Rights and Social Development Division (HRSD), Statistics for Development Division (SDD), and Pacific Women Lead. Our core funding supplements SPC's corporate backbone as our Partners in the Blue Pacific investments come on stream, including Pacific Humanitarian Warehouse Program and the Pacific Research Vessel.
